lesson: The system is consistently attempting to short local lows during a markdown phase, falling victim to mean-reversion bounces that occur when momentum stalls. These losses indicate that the strategy is misinterpreting oversold conditions as continuation signals rather than potential Wyckoffian 'Springs' or demand absorption zones.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish retest of a broken support level (SMC flip) before entering any further shorts, rather than entering based on EMA alignment alone.
methodology_flag: Trust EMA trend-following less on SEIUSDT; prioritize Wyckoff accumulation patterns to identify exhaustion.
